topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: When I heard the news about the building going condo, a part of me sank, yet I couldn’t help but find a gentle silver lining. Change, after all, brings new possibilities. The familiar slowly merging with the unknown, like old pages turning to new chapters. I thought about the neighbors, wondering how they felt, and hoped they found comfort in whatever decision they made. For myself, I allowed the thought of a fresh start to warm me. It’s a shift, yes, but perhaps one that opens doors to new connections and experiences, a reminder that we can grow and adapt, no matter the changes that come our way.
